integrity: The source representation theorem and converse were inspected in full text. The new bijection is proved through the intrinsic quotient \(\mathbb F_2^n/C\), and the count is exactly the number of linear injections into \(\mathbb F_{2^M}\) times the number of anchors. A standalone finite-field verifier exhaustively enumerates representative small cases and checks their kernels directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts anchored, coordinate-labeled degree-one representations of a fixed binary code. It does not quotient by coordinate permutations, field automorphisms, or projective equivalence, and applies only when \(d(C)\ge3\).
title: Complete parameterization of degree-one binary Goppa realizations
